title: Ultrasonic texture features for assessing abnormal interventricular septum motion following cardiac surgery
summary: Ultrasound texture features differed with abnormal postoperative septal motion, and an SVM classifier distinguished the groups in a retrospective two-center study. External-center AUC was 0.803, below internal performance; the result supports a diagnostic association, not improved clinical outcomes.
ai_technology: LASSO feature selection and logistic-regression, random-forest, and SVM classifiers analyze ultrasound texture and shape features.
organization: Not stated in the reviewed journal article

evidence.tested: Among 650 patients, texture differences were associated with abnormal septal motion; SVM AUC was 0.943 in training, 0.948 internally, and 0.803 in an external-center cohort.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective diagnostic study; external performance was lower, and prospective clinical benefit was not tested. Online date 2026-10-19 precedes the 2026-11-01 issue date.
evidence.ai_role: Learned classification of echocardiographic features enabled an evaluated association with postoperative septal motion.

source_review.scope: Primary source full-text Methods and Results; version date and reported validation scope checked.
